concepts.title: Entering the Real World: Tasks of Adulthood
concepts.definition: Adulthood opens into what the chapter calls the real world: higher education and work, intimate partnership and marriage, and eventually parenthood. Each step brings new roles, responsibilities and the need to balance personal goals with obligations to others.
concepts.key_idea: Adulthood is the balancing act -- career, partnership and parenthood each demanding a share of the self.
concepts.textbook_ref: kehe203.txt unit opener (unit iv adulthood, real world of higher education work marriage, roles and responsibilities)
question_patterns: what major transitions mark the entry into adulthood
in class 11 adulthood unit: why is adulthood called the real world
what responsibilities accompany work and marriage

solution_steps.explain: Entry into work and higher education, formation of partnerships, and parenthood are adulthood's signature steps.
Each step adds obligations -- earning, sharing decisions, caring for dependants.
Maturity shows in managing these demands without losing personal growth and health.

concepts.title: Work, Marriage and Family: Institutions of Adult Life
concepts.definition: Adult life organises itself around institutions: the workplace, which structures income, identity and time; marriage, a social and legal partnership carrying mutual duties; and the family, where parenthood raises the next generation. Adjustment, communication and shared responsibility keep these institutions working.
concepts.key_idea: Work pays the bills, marriage shares the load, family gives it meaning -- institutions joined by adjustment.
concepts.textbook_ref: kehe203.txt unit opener and institution sections (work, marriage and family, adjustment, communication, shared responsibility)
question_patterns: what roles do work marriage and family play in adult life
in class 11 adulthood unit: why is adjustment important in marriage

solution_steps.explain: Employment brings income, routine and social identity -- plus the discipline of responsibility.
Marriage requires communication, adjustment of habits and shared decision making between equals.
Parenthood extends responsibility to the next generation, redirecting time and resources.

concepts.title: Challenges and Coping in Adult Life
concepts.definition: Adulthood carries predictable stresses -- career pressure, financial strain, family conflicts, and later, ageing parents and health changes. Coping rests on planning, health maintenance, social support and flexibility of roles as life's stages turn.
concepts.key_idea: Stress is scheduled into adult life -- planning, health and support are the shock absorbers.
concepts.textbook_ref: kehe203.txt unit opener and challenge sections (career and financial pressures, ageing, health, coping strategies, social support)
question_patterns: what stresses are typical of adult life

solution_steps.explain: Name them -- deadlines, loans, quarrels, illness, ageing -- so they arrive as expected guests, not shocks.
Savings, health routines and supportive relationships absorb what life delivers.
Roles shift with each stage; adults who renegotiate duties rather than defend them cope best.

worked_examples.question_pattern: A student asks why school called adolescence preparation for the 'real world'. Explain using the tasks of adulthood.

solution_template.explain: Higher education, earning work, partnership and parenthood await after adolescence.
Skills learned now -- discipline, decision making, health habits -- are exactly the tools those tasks consume.
Adolescence is rehearsal; adulthood is the performance the chapter calls the real world.

worked_examples.question_pattern: A couple faces a sudden salary cut while raising two children. Suggest a coping plan using the chapter's approach.

solution_template.explain: Financial strain threatens the family's obligations and stability.
Rework the budget, use savings deliberately, seek additional income, and inform trusted family for support.
Communicate decisions jointly to keep stress from turning into blame -- adjustment keeps the family working.
